MediaPipe Tasks Vision 0.10.21, Google, Apache-2.0. Package: https://registry.npmjs.org/@mediapipe/tasks-vision/-/tasks-vision-0.10.21.tgz
The official ESM bundle is wrapped in an IIFE with exports assigned to self.Vision, for classic-worker loading. Model and inference code unchanged. SIMD runtime bundled; browsers without SIMD/WebGL use the retained face-api CPU worker.
Face Landmarker model: https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-models/face_landmarker/face_landmarker/float16/1/face_landmarker.task
